name: detail-D-wall_foundation-EXT_2X6_BOARD_BAT-723a2b
notes: • Framed wall: 2x6 at 16" o.c., R-19 bays, 4" continuous exterior.
• Pour and steel per the S-100 schedule.
• 60 mil waterproofing, footing to grade (Minn. R. 1309.0406).
K1  Bituthene 3000 or equal, concrete to sheathing; 2" laps, 2-ply corners; backfill in 30 days.
K2  Z-flashing with drip at the girt band base, set to the 2" cavity.
K3  2"x2" perforated aluminium U on the Z; base trim 1" up, lapping it on EPDM.
K4  L-flashing from sheathing base onto the foam; seal its outer end.
K5  Mudsill anchors per IRC R403.1.6. Plate joint peel-and-stick on the envelope.
K7  Veneer: 1 15/16" air over 2+2" XPS, weeps at the beam; W2.8 adjustable ties at 6 1/2" brick to stud.
